Done. The pruned checkpoint is at `out/T2/model.safetensors` and the plan at `out/T2/plan.yaml`.

**Approach.** The plan avoids 64 per-tensor concat blocks by working pattern-wise over all layers. It allocates a 1920-row or 1920-column scratch tensor per projection with `fill` using a sliced source for the shape, then copies the kept slices into it with two sliced `assign` steps, deletes the originals, and moves the scratch tensors back under the original names. The five required checks plus preflight and per-layer shape checks are `assert` transforms placed before the output is written.

**Executions.**

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| 1 | Failed on an extra check I added, not on the surgery. A `count ... is: 0` check raises on zero matches, so it cannot express "no scratch left". |
| 2 | Passed. All 24 transforms ran and 114 tensors were written. |

I replaced the zero-count check with a `not: exists` assertion. No partial output was left by the first run since it failed before the save step.

**Verification.** A separate check-only plan under `out/T2/verify/` loads both the input and the output and confirms 114 float32 tensors, pruned shapes on all 16 layers, bit-equality of every untouched tensor, and piece-wise bit-equality of the kept row and column blocks for every pruned projection. All nine checks pass. The self-report is in `out/T2/REPORT.md`.
